name: Sera FX
description: Cross-border stablecoin FX for autonomous agents: live rates, corridors, deal scanning, quotes, and non-custodial EIP-712 settlement intents. Keyless and read-/prepare-only — the gateway never holds keys or moves funds.

skills.name: FX rates
skills.description: Live reference rates for one or more BASE/QUOTE stablecoin pairs.
examples: Get the USDC/BRLA and XSGD/IDRX rates.

skills.name: List corridors
skills.description: Supported FX corridors (currency pairs) and their liquidity depth.

skills.name: FX deal scanner
skills.description: Scan markets in parallel, diff each against external mid, and rank the best-priced corridors.
examples: Find FX deals better than 25 bps across the majors.

skills.name: FX quote
skills.description: Price a conversion between two supported stablecoins; returns amount_out, mid_rate, and a quote_id.

skills.name: FX settle
skills.description: Build an unsigned EIP-712 settlement intent from a quote_id for the caller to sign in their own wallet.
examples: Prepare a settlement intent for quote_id abc123.
